reason: I choose my own vegetables, fruit and meat, and I'm not handing that to a stranger with a list. I already go down to Jbeil on Saturday for the big shop, so a $2 fee on top of my groceries buys me nothing I need.
objection: Someone else picks my fresh food and I pay an extra $2 every bag for it. With money this tight I can't risk paying for tomatoes or meat I would have rejected at the shop.
would_change_my_mind: A way to send back or not pay for anything I don't like when I open the bag, and a fee of about $1 or less.
